notes.title: The Hookmarine is OUT NOW.
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm glad to announce that The Hookmarine is out now. You can play, upload your times to the leaderboard, earn achievements and share your experience with everyone.

Thanks in advance for the people supporting me and my small games, it really means a lot.

I hope you like the game. I love this game and I will add more content to it, I have some modes already planned!
